Here’s what happens when you try to "vibe code" GTA 6 using Claude Code 🔥

Sure, it's nowhere near AAA game standards yet, but it's remarkably impressive considering how it was built.

The entire project evolved over 22 hours using 86 AI agents running iterative workflows—all starting from a single initial prompt.

We're still in the early stages of AI-assisted development, but experiments like this show just how rapidly things are progressing :)
